thread.content: We need to pick a launch date for the mobile app.
Based on the QA report, the earliest safe date is 12 May. The payments integration still has two open bugs.
Marketing wants 5 May. Can we make that?
Not safely: 5 May leaves no time for the two payments bugs. We agreed to launch on 12 May and to freeze features on 28 April.
Summarise what we know about customer churn in Q3.
Churn fell from 4.2% to 3.1% in Q3. The largest drop was in the annual plan segment, down 2.4 points. Monthly plans were flat at 5.0%.
Offer annual plans to monthly customers who have stayed more than 6 months, and review the cancellation survey in November.
Help me plan a 3-day trip to Lisbon.
Day 1: Alfama and the castle. Day 2: Belem, the tower and the pastry shop. Day 3: a day trip to Sintra by train from Rossio.
Add a note about getting around.
Buy a Viva Viagem card at the airport; trams 28 and 15 cover most sights.
Explain how our on-call rotation works.
On-call rotates weekly on Mondays at 10:00. The primary answers pages within 10 minutes; the secondary takes over after 20 minutes. Handover notes go in the #ops-handover channel.

web.title: Announcing Rust 1.85 and the 2024 edition
web.content: The Rust 2024 edition stabilised with 1.85. Highlights: async closures, let chains in if conditions, and the new RPIT lifetime capture rules.

web.title: Migrating to the 2024 edition
web.content: Run cargo fix --edition to migrate. Most projects need few manual changes; the guide lists the lints that help.

web.title: AI Act: key dates
web.content: The AI Act entered into force in August 2024. Prohibitions apply from February 2025 and the rules for general-purpose models from August 2025.
